fusions.name: Avalanche Shoulder
fusions.desc: A crushing shoulder-charge that deals 18 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quake Clap
fusions.desc: Slams both fists into the ground, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Bedrock Brace
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Heavy Hand Falls
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
